title.narrative: Sub-National Level Financial Management Capacity Building Project

description.narrative: 1. Component: Strengthening the capacity of Financial Management staff in provinces. Component 1 intends to strengthen the capacity of Financial Management staff in the provinces by providing face to face training workshops in basic accounting, IT, communication, record management and Public sector financial management in Kabul through local professional consultants and staff of MoF. Each work shop will last for one week for 100 participants from the selected provinces including the most insecure provinces. Eight such workshops are expected to take place during the life of the project. Outcome: Improved skills and performance of the FM staff at provincial level, timely and efficient reporting to the central ministries in Kabul. Activity: Training of the provincial FM staff Output: A local consultancy firm will be recruited to provide training to the staff from various selected provinces for selected ministries in Kabul. The training would include basic IT, communication, accounting, record management and Public sector financial management. 2. Component: Improving the communication system in provinces This component has arrangements to procure IT equipment e.g., computers, printers and scanners for better communication, financial recording and reporting purposes for the Financial Management staff in the provinces Outcome: Improved communication between the provincial FM staff and the central ministries, improved accountability and timely financial reporting. Activity: Purchase of IT equipments to enable better and timely communication e.g Computers, software, scanners, printers and fast speed internet connection. Output: Familiarity of staff with use of IT equipments, improved record retention and timely submission of documents and reports to the central ministry via internet uploading. The Project Development Objective of the proposed IDF Grant is to strengthen the skills and capacities of the financial management staff of line ministries in four provinces.
